It also enjoys a large community base, and various mods are released regularly. With the 20th Anniversary Update for the base Half-Life 2 on November 15, 2024, both Episodes and [[Half-Life 2: Lost Coast|Lost Coast]] were merged into the default game (as the {{code|hl2_complete}} "mod", individual parts accessible from the main menu) and were moved to the Tools section in the Steam library. Purchasing them as a single package became the only way of obtaining them, with prior owners of any part of the collection receiving any missing content. This beta adds Linux support and converts the game to the new Steam Content delivery system. }} }} ===Middleware=== {{Middleware |physics = Havok |physics notes = Heavily modified variant. |audio = Miles Sound System |audio notes = |interface = VGUI2 |interface notes = |input = SDL |input notes = |cutscenes = Bink Video |cutscenes notes = Used for the startup video. |multiplayer = |multiplayer notes= |anticheat = |anticheat notes = }} === Restoring original content from cut Steam versions (e.g. German)=== The German Steam version can have its cut content restored with two steps: {{Fixbox|description=Edit the config file|ref={{Refcheck|user=Stuttgart|date=2025-02-07|comment=}}|fix=
  1. Go to \steamapps\common\hl2\cfg\
  2. Create a new file: autoexec.cfg
  3. Set the content to:
    violence_agibs "1"
    violence_hgibs "1"
    violence_hblood "1"
    violence_ablood "1"
    cl_show_bloodspray "1"
    cl_detailfade "3500"
    cl_ragdoll_collide "1"
    g_ragdoll_lvfadespeed "0"
    g_ragdoll_fadespeed "0"
    g_ragdoll_maxcount "50"
  4. To make those changes to other campaigns, do the same in other sub-folders (other than ''\hl2\'').
